'''Lynx Reglis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an impersonator to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]] and later a fugitive to the Empire.

==Biography==
[[File:Zafiro.jpg|left|thumb|[[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]], whom Lynx Reglis impersonated.]]
The daughter of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Aelon Reglis]] and his wife, Lynx Reglis went to the [[Corulag Academy]] and graduated as an [[Internal Security Branch|IntSec]] investigator. Her father gave her his ship, the [[Adventurer (Crescent-class)|''Adventurer'']], a [[Crescent-class Transport|''Crescent''-class transport]] Mark II built by [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]], as a graduation gift, partly because he had almost not used the ship in eighteen years. He hoped she could use the ship more than him.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Officer Lynx was then assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on [[Nigel III]], in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]], and she performed many planetary activities, not using her ship.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

At a certain point, [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Dane Tizzin]], Naval attach to the staff of the sectorial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], became the target of an assassination plot. Officer Reglis impersonated [[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]], a smuggler and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent, to save Tizzin.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

She then decided to replace the ''Adventurer's'' [[sensor package]] with a [[counter-sensor package]] to have a stealthy ship, something she reasoned could be useful. Before she and a technician could finish the customization, Lynx was implicated in an information leak of the Nigel base, and she was forced to flee from the Imperial military justice. She left behind her ship and other personal possessions for the Empire to impound.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
